title: What Does Medtronic (MDT) FDA Clearance Mean For Its Hugo Surgery Push?

summary: Johnson & Johnson (JNJ) stock has returned about 57% over the past year, against about 17% for the S&P 500. On the earnings it has already banked, that price looks expensive.
